target_customer: Mid-market and enterprise data teams and AI innovation teams
problem: Companies want conversational analytics but need governed, grounded answers they can trust.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform for building and deploying data agents

founders.name: Ka Ling Wu
founders.background_notes: Helped lead Palantir HyperAuto and opened its Korea market per YC page.

founders.name: Serguei Balanovich
founders.background_notes: Dev lead on Palantir Apollo per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Text to SQL agents with a governed context layer and evaluation tooling are standard LLM engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Encoded business context creates some lock-in, but BI incumbents and data platforms ship similar agents.

market_need_then: Enterprises were piloting natural language analytics in 2024; founders say they built a similar product at Palantir with 50+ enterprise customers (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses upsolve.ai; Upsolve nonprofit (debt relief) and Upsolver (data) are separate.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with the nonprofit Upsolve and Upsolver, and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Upsolve AI is active. Its early blog positioning targeted embedded analytics versus Sisense, and its current site sells governed data agents, though the exact pivot date is not sourced. Founders from Palantir give enterprise credibility. Funding is thin and unverified, and no outcome news exists, so the story is incomplete.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators list about 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator (possibly Soma Capital); Latka claims bootstrapped; nonprofit Upsolve figures (Gates Foundation 4M) are a different entity. No round recorded. No dated competitor sources near January 2024 were found (only 2025 and 2026 vendor pages), so the list is empty. Pivot from embedded analytics to data agents suggested by the blog but not dated, so no pivot entry. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed dated 2024-01 is recorded from VCBacked (another database dates it 2024-02-14; Latka says bootstrapped). Single database basis; no press found.
